preconditions.description: The number of gnomes is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The number of minutes can be between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
The creator's id is between 1 and N, inclusive.
The friendship matrix contains only 0s and 1s.

postconditions.expression: output[0] == number of gnomes who know the joke after k minutes
postconditions.description: The first line of output for each query must contain the count of gnomes who will know the joke after k minutes.

postconditions.expression: output[1] == sorted list of ids of gnomes who know the joke after k minutes
postconditions.description: The second line of output for each query must contain the sorted list of ids of gnomes who will know the joke after k minutes.

invariants.description: No gnome is friends with itself.

invariants.expression: all(g[i][j] == g[j][i] for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
